question: Where is it smart to open a coffee place in Kreuzberg?
report_md:
The strongest default locations are **Reichenberger Straße Ost**, Lausitzer Platz, and Graefekiez Nord, ranked from the PLR cell mix [1]. Dense, younger cells score well on demand, while the IHK-registered and OSM café inventories remain separate measures of competition [2] [3] [4].

The announced Moritzplatz office campus and Köpenicker Straße housing project raise future potential in their respective cells [9] [10]. Wrangelkiez has a high-severity rent risk reflecting the reported 18 % rise [11].
